title: ProductCategoryDataTranslation - Data API
description: Represents the translated values for the data stored within a ProductCategory record’s fields. This object is available in API version 46.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The translated value for the Product Category description.

IsOutOfDate.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsOutOfDate.description: Indicates whether the translation is out-of-date (true) or current (false). A translation is out-of-date if the parent ProductCategory record is updated after the last translation was filed.

Language.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Language.description: The language for these translated values.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The translated value for the Product Category name.

ParentId.description: The ID of the category being translated.

usage: Use this object to translate the data stored in a Product Category record into the different languages supported by Salesforce. If data translation is enabled for custom fields on the ProductCategory object, additional ProductCategoryDataTranslation fields exist for translating the data contained within those fields.
